messages:
anna: heads-up: new set of CVEs popped up across protobuf, sentencepiece, Triton packaging, and a FlashAttention kernel edge case. digging through impact now, but flagging here so we can coordinate triage and rollout. CVEs i have so far: CVE-2026-0456 (protobuf deserialization/high), CVE-2026-0789 (sentencepiece DoS/medium), CVE-2026-1101 (triton packaging vuln/medium), CVE-2026-1023 (flashattention kernel oob/info-leak/medium).
li: thx. can you paste upstream advisories? also which images/services use these libs (hosted api runtime, dedicated pools, private images)?
anna: pasted links in ticket INC-2026-72 (sec-bot updated thread). quick mapping: protobuf used by core runtime + vLLM NLP pipelines; sentencepiece in some tokenizers we ship with model bundles (mostly for certain open models); Triton is used only in our triton-backed Dedicated pools; FlashAttention kernels are bundled in our optimized runtime image for GPU inference (affects both hosted and dedicated).
matt: initial risk call: protobuf fix is highest priority. if it's a deserialization issue we should patch immediately on hosted API path and Dedicated control plane. can we hotpatch the python wheel vs rebuild image? what's the upstream fix (minor bump?)
li: upstream released protobuf 4.24.1 with the fix. for python wheel we can pip upgrade in containers, but our running servers are pinned images - safer to build new runtime images with pinned 4.24.1 and roll. hotpatching container will be messy for stateful gpu processes. recommend image rebuild + canary.
oliver: impact on Private customers: we can't push images into air-gapped installs. need advisories + CVSS and mitigation steps for customers to apply patches themselves. also ensure audit logs capture the image rollout and key changes. KMS: no direct crypto vuln here, but any restart might re-encrypt caches — verify we rotate kms keys? parallel note: add RBAC entries for who can trigger emergency rollouts.
sam: propose rollout plan: 1) protobuf image build + CI regression and security scan. 2) canary to 5% traffic on hosted (or isolated dedicated pool) for 1h, check latency/err, token throughput. 3) expand to 25% then 100% over 6h if stable. For Dedicated, schedule maintenance window and notify customers. For Private, publish advisory + backport guidance.
anna: agreed. for Triton and FlashAttention i think we can batch those into the same rebuild where possible to limit churn. Triton fix is a packaging issue (no runtime exploit observed in our infra) so mark medium priority. FlashAttention kernel needs CUDA toolkit rebuild on our optimization branch — that will need a full image rebuild and GPU smoke tests.
li: i'll open the image build PRs: runtime-image:v2026-03-21-protobuf and runtime-image:v2026-03-21-gpupatch. will include protobuf 4.24.1, Triton 2.18.3 patched build, and FlashAttention kernel commit hash mentioned in upstream patch. will run the existing perf suite (latency, throughput, memory) and a few stress tests for token cache correctness.
sec-bot: Ticket created: INC-2026-72. Labels: vuln-triage, critical-hosted, dedicated, advisory-needed. Linked CVEs: [CVE-2026-0456, CVE-2026-0789, CVE-2026-1101, CVE-2026-1023].
oliver: for auditing: add a log hook to the rollout automation to emit rollout:<image>:<sha> events to splunk and to customer audit logs (private). Also bump retention for vulnerability-related events for 1y. can engineering ops handle that hook in next 4 hours?
matt: yes, we can add emits in the deploy pipeline. code snippet for canary command i used before:

```
# deploy canary image to hosted pool
rdctl deploy --pool hosted-api --image runtime-image:v2026-03-21-protobuf --traffic 5%
rdctl monitor --check latency,errors,kps --window 10m
```

sam: monitoring: add synthetic prompts and a small eval set to check generation drift/score after protobuf change. we should also validate kv-cache corruption cases.
li: one wrinkle: some internal teams pin sentencepiece in model bundles to old builds. sentencepiece fix (4.7.1) is low/medium; we'll include it but mark as optional in initial canary. will send a note to model-ops to republish bundles.
anna: decision: protobuf patch = P0 for hosted. Triton/FlashAttention = P1 (coordinated rebuild, medium risk). sentencepiece = P2 (include in image but notify model-ops to republish). Actions assigned: li -> build images + PRs; matt -> canary rollout + monitoring; sam -> synth tests + KV cache checks; oliver -> customer advisory + audit hook; anna -> coordinate status comms and compile postmortem if anything goes wrong.
li: ETA: initial PRs in ~2 hours, CI in ~4. will request expedited review.
anna: thanks. i'll post an incident advisory draft in #announcements after we confirm hosted canary start. :eyes:
matt: i'll kick off canary when li says images are in registry. :thumbsup:
sam: +1, will watch metrics and post results here.
sec-bot: Reminder: follow disclosure timeline policy. Do not share exploit details publicly until customers notified and patches released.
